description: Configuration for rotor asset sync and rotor deploy.

assets.description: Configures rotor asset sync and the $asset macro.

base.description: Project-relative directory prepended to non-relative $asset paths, e.g. "assets/images" lets you write $asset("ui/icon.png") for assets/images/ui/icon.png. Does not affect paths globs, ./-relative references, or lockfile keys.

creator.description: The Roblox creator that owns uploaded assets.

id.description: The user or group id that owns uploaded assets.

type.description: Whether the owning creator is a user or a group.

mode.description: How assets reach Luau: "module" generates assets.luau + assets.d.ts (default); "macro" uses the $asset transformer + rotor-asset.d.ts.

output.description: Where generated asset modules are written (module mode only).

luau.description: Output path of the generated Luau module, e.g. "src/shared/assets.luau".

types.description: Output path of the matching .d.ts, e.g. "src/shared/assets.d.ts".

paths.description: Glob patterns of asset files relative to the project root.

additionalProperties.description: A badge to create or update.

badges.description: Badges to create or update, keyed by a logical name.

privateServers.description: Paid private servers; omit price for free private servers.

price.description: Private server price in Robux (0 = free).

additionalProperties.description: A game pass to create or update; omit price to leave it off sale.

price.description: Game pass price in Robux; omit to keep it off sale.

gamepasses.description: Game passes to create or update, keyed by a logical name.

payments.description: Payments configuration tag for the environment.

additionalProperties.description: Publishes a built place file to a place id (and optionally manages place metadata).

file.description: Path to the built place file (.rbxl / .rbxlx).

placeId.description: The place id to publish to.

versionType.description: Whether to save or publish the place version (default "published").

places.description: Places to publish in this environment, keyed by a logical name.

additionalProperties.description: A developer product to create or update.

products.description: Developer products to create or update, keyed by a logical name.

socials.description: Universe social links, keyed by a logical name.

universeId.description: The universe id this environment publishes to.

after.description: Run native Flamework after this remaining TypeScript transformer.

hashPrefix.description: Optional identifier hash prefix; values beginning with $ are reserved.

idGenerationMode.description: Identifier generation mode. Defaults to full, or obfuscated when obfuscation is enabled.

noSemanticDiagnostics.description: Disable TypeScript semantic diagnostics during Flamework transformation.

obfuscation.description: Enable Flamework identifier and event-name obfuscation.

skipUnchangedFiles.description: Reuse the original parse tree for sources Flamework leaves unchanged instead of reprinting them (opts out of upstream source-print parity).

profiles.description: Per-tsconfig native Flamework settings, keyed by normalized path relative to rotor.toml.

skipUnchangedFiles.description: Reuse the original parse tree for sources Flamework leaves unchanged instead of reprinting them (opts out of upstream source-print parity).

title: rotor.toml
